method.clock: perf_counter_ns, elapsed milliseconds, p95 nearest-rank; source/data hashing and JSON/statistics work are outside timers
method.startup: Fresh Engine construction per phase; no learning path. Filesystem cache is uncontrolled and fingerprint reads precede construction, so these are not cold-disk measurements.
method.changing_queries: Corpus order is fixed. Each seed starts at its first character; every prefix is a distinct query from the immediately preceding (input, mode). One Engine stays alive within each phase and all passes; later passes reuse base/prefix caches but not the identical-query ranked snapshot.
method.session: One character per Session.handle_key call, including apostrophes. Time ends when SessionResult and visible first page (up to9) are available. Reset between seeds is outside timing. No commit, selection, rendering, keystroke pacing, IPC or native host is measured.
method.backend: Separate fresh Engine phases for lookup limits9 and90 prevent cross-phase snapshot reuse. Numeric-tone seeds are included here. Timed calls are sequential, without artificial cache clearing or timed instrumentation callbacks.
method.snapshot: Each full-input query is primed outside repeated-hit timers, then exactly repeated. These cache-hit timings do not represent changing input.
method.limits: Existing40 development seeds only, not a representative or held-out workload. Shared-machine scheduling/OS cache are uncontrolled. Native candidate-update target cannot be assessed by this harness. Errors remain in traces and invalidate successful-run status.
